import openpyxl
import os

# Paths
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/160-6/1_160-6_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/160-6_1_b4cf90b7/1_160-6_output.xlsx"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb['SH']

print(f"Original sheet dimensions: {ws.max_row} rows x {ws.max_column} columns")

# The answer_position is 'SH'!A6:L11, which means rows 6-11
# We need to delete blank rows in this range and shift remaining rows up

# First, identify which rows in the range 6-11 are blank
blank_rows = []
for row_idx in range(6, 12):  # rows 6-11 (inclusive)
    row_values = [ws.cell(row_idx, col).value for col in range(1, 13)]  # columns A-L (1-12)
    is_blank = all(v is None for v in row_values)
    if is_blank:
        blank_rows.append(row_idx)
        print(f"Row {row_idx} is blank")

print(f"\nBlank rows to delete: {blank_rows}")

# Delete blank rows from bottom to top (to avoid index shifting issues)
for row_idx in sorted(blank_rows, reverse=True):
    ws.delete_rows(row_idx, 1)
    print(f"Deleted row {row_idx}")

print(f"\nNew sheet dimensions: {ws.max_row} rows x {ws.max_column} columns")

# Verify the result
print("\nRows 1-15 after deletion:")
for row_idx in range(1, min(16, ws.max_row + 1)):
    row_values = [ws.cell(row_idx, col).value for col in range(1, min(4, ws.max_column + 1))]
    print(f"Row {row_idx}: {row_values}")

# Save the workbook
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\nSaved to: {output_path}")
